cache.note: item detail and search pages are cached in this process for the TTLs above, and every answer that can come from the cache says so in a `cache` block. Set XIANYU_CACHE=0 to turn it off; nothing else in this server is cached, and the homepage feed deliberately is not -- goofish serves each visitor a different slice of it, so a repeat call is a different answer rather than a stale copy.

works_without_account: search_count / search_suggest: inventory estimate and autocomplete
search_items: relevant product cards and optional shortlist detail
anonymous_flakiness: Anonymous page loads can be refused or throttled; no tool is guaranteed to succeed.
A positive inventory estimate does not guarantee retrievable or relevant search cards.
Throttle cooldown is local to this process; other clients may share its public IP.
notes: Unknown fields stay null and are named in missing or fields_missing.
Filters run on fetched cards. Title evidence cannot establish hardware facts that the seller omitted.
A continuation preserves original search controls and unreturned cards for ten minutes in this process.
A virtual display is started automatically when DISPLAY and XIANYU_DISPLAY are absent; Xvfb must be installed.

cost.search: Warm page reuse and cached pages avoid navigation. Actual latency depends on the site; use timeout_s.
cost.detail: Optional full listing loads are expensive; request a shortlist. Per-listing times are in detail_report.

data.note: Inspect each live probe and its error field. Unmeasured probes are null; an unsuccessful probe does not establish zero inventory or an anonymous session.

probes.note: the four keys above are conclusions of live probes against goofish; a probe that failed reports under its own <key>_error rather than being folded into a verdict

cooldown.note: Goofish may throttle a shared public IP. This process cannot measure other clients on that IP.
